Entry.JapaneseText: くそ、なんだこの嵐は……!? 一瞬で自分の位置を見失っちゃった
Entry.EnglishText: Damn, what's with this sandstorm?! We're all turned around!

Entry.JapaneseText: 大丈夫。 とにかく北を目指せば みんなと合流できるさ
Entry.EnglishText: Everything will be fine. All we gotta do is head north and meet back up with everyone.

Entry.JapaneseText: 急ごう。集合に遅れたら <Hisui>や<Ines>に 何言われるかわからないからね
Entry.EnglishText: Let's hurry. Hisui and Ines will tear strips off us if we're late.
...Okay!

Entry.JapaneseText: うわああッ!! オレの手を掴んで！
Entry.EnglishText: Whoa!! Here, take my hand!
Eeek...!
Kohaku! KOHAKUUU!!

Entry.JapaneseText: うぅッ………… もう北がどっちかも わからなく……なっちゃった……
Entry.EnglishText: Ugh... which way was north again...I'm so... lost...
Huh...? My body just... gave out...
Dammit... I have to... keep gooing...

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは……<Kohaku>を…… 元に戻さなきゃいけない……んだ
Entry.EnglishText: I still... need to help Kohaku...
...I really can't... go on...
Sorry... <Kohaku>...

Entry.JapaneseText: はは……変だな、オレ…… 自分が……死にそうなのに <Kohaku>の事ばっか考えてる
Entry.EnglishText: Haha... it's funny... here I am... dying... but all I can think about is Kohaku.

Entry.JapaneseText: …………そっか、オレって こんなにあの子の事が…………
Entry.EnglishText: ...Oh, I get it. She...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……死にたく……………… ……ない……な………… もう一度きみに……会いたい……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I don't... wanna...die... I wanna... see you one last time...
...Shing... where are you?
Wha...t is this feeling...?!
...I'm right here...
Kohaku! I just heard her voice!!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレはここだよッ!! ここにいるよーーーッ！！！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm here! Over here!!

Entry.JapaneseText: これは……スピルーン反応!? …………いや、違う！
Entry.EnglishText: Is this... a Spirune?! No, it feels different!

Entry.JapaneseText: ソーマがスピリアをつなげて くれてる！ この光の先に <Kohaku>がいるのがわかる!!
Entry.EnglishText: Our Soma are connecting our Spirias! I can see her at the end of the light!!

Entry.JapaneseText: 最悪だ！ こんな所で ひとりになるなんてなッ！
Entry.EnglishText: This freakin' sucks! I can't believe I'm stranded out here with nobody else!

Entry.JapaneseText: ひとりではない。 自分も同行している
Entry.EnglishText: You are not alone. I am also present.

Entry.JapaneseText: へっ、人間は俺『ひとり』さ！ てめぇは『一個』だろ、機械野郎
Entry.EnglishText: Heh, I said noBODY! That dosen't count tin-cans like you!

Entry.JapaneseText: 自分を傷つけようと 意図した発言なら、見当違いだ
Entry.EnglishText: If that statement was intended to hurt me, you did not succeed.

Entry.JapaneseText: 自分は、忠実かつ的確に 主に仕える機械存在である事に 誇りを持っている
Entry.EnglishText: I take pride in being a machine that faithfully and reliably serves my Master.

Entry.JapaneseText: 主……『リチア様』ってか？ そいつも許せねぇんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Master... you mean Lithia, right? Tch, I'll never forgive that self-centered bastard.

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの<Kohaku>を たぶらかしやがって。 復活したら、ぶん殴ってやる!!
Entry.EnglishText: How dare she put all those dumb ideas in my sister's head. As soon as she's recovered, I'm gonna sock her in the face!

Entry.JapaneseText: 警告。 本気で実行するつもりならば 自分はオマエを排除する
Entry.EnglishText: Warning. If that is truly your intentions, I will have to eliminate you.

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ!? やんのか、こらぁッ！
Entry.EnglishText: What was that?! You wanna go, punk?

Entry.JapaneseText: 気象条件悪化。 主と器……<Kohaku>の保護が 最優先事項だ。合流を急ぐぞ
Entry.EnglishText: Weather conditions deteriorating. Our primary objective is protecting my Master and the vessel... Kohaku. We must make haste.
Wait, get back here!

Entry.JapaneseText: ったく、<Shing>にコイツ…… <Kohaku>もロクでもない 奴ばかりに好かれやがる！
Entry.EnglishText: Dammit, between Shing and this guy... why does Kohaku gotta keep drawing in a bad crowd?!
Huff, huff...

Entry.JapaneseText: どうしたエネルギー切れか？
Entry.EnglishText: Are you running low on energy?

Entry.JapaneseText: うるせぇ！ てめぇこそ砂が詰まって 壊れかかってんじゃねぇのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Shut it! Isn't it about time you get clogged with sand and break down already?

Entry.JapaneseText: 今のは…… クソでけぇサンドワームの鳴き声!?
Entry.EnglishText: Was that... the sandworm?!

Entry.JapaneseText: データ照合。 サンドワームの捕食時の 発声音と確認
Entry.EnglishText: Collating data. That vocalization is indicitive of the sandworm anticipating its prey.

Entry.JapaneseText: くっ、<Kohaku>たちが危ねぇ！ 急ぐぞ、機械野郎!!
Entry.EnglishText: Dammit, nobody's safe! C'mon you bucket of bolts, let's get a move on!
Understood!

Entry.JapaneseText: あうぅ〜〜 もう無理だよぉ、<Ines>ぅ〜 おとなしく帰ろうよぉ……
Entry.EnglishText: Ugh, I can't go on... Ines, can't we just head back already?
...I'm afraid not.

Entry.JapaneseText: だって、帰り道を 見失っちゃったんだものぉ〜
Entry.EnglishText: I'm not sure which way is back, now.

Entry.JapaneseText: がぁぁ〜〜んっ!! まぁ〜じぃ〜でぇぇ〜〜〜っ!?
Entry.EnglishText: WHAAAT!?! You gotta be kidding...

Entry.JapaneseText: 多分、北に向って進めば平気よ。 運び屋の勘を信じて∀
Entry.EnglishText: We should... probably be fine as long as we head north. Call it, a courier's intuition. Just trust me. ∀

Entry.JapaneseText: 多分って何？ 勘ってなんだよ?? ここは計画立てても抜けられない キョーフの砂漠だってのにぃっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Whaddaya mean PROBABLY?! How do you expect me to trust you when YOU'RE not even convinced?!

Entry.JapaneseText: うわ〜ん、もし死んだら <Ines>を呪ってやる〜っ！
Entry.EnglishText: Uuuugh, if I die I'm TOTALLY haunting you!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Beryl>…… ひとつだけ言っておくわ
Entry.EnglishText: Beryl... I have to tell you something.
W-what is it?

Entry.JapaneseText: あなたが死んだら ソーマだけはもらって売り払うけど それは了解してね♪
Entry.EnglishText: If you die, I'm taking your Soma and selling it, I hope you can understand! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: 頭きた〜〜っ！ <Ines>がその気なら ボクは死んでも死なないからねっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ooh that is IT! I don't care how bad you want it, even if I die I ain't dying!

Entry.JapaneseText: あら、失敗。 余計な事言わない方が よかったかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh my. Maybe a went too far?

Entry.JapaneseText: あうぅ…… も、ダメかも…… <Ines>、最後のお願いだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Ugh,,, this is really the end... Ines, I have one dying wish.

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクのソーマは せめて芸術家に 売り飛ばしてねぇ……
Entry.EnglishText: At the very least... please sell my Soma to an artist...

Entry.JapaneseText: しっかりしなさい！ 死んでも死なないって 言ったのは誰？
Entry.EnglishText: Keep it together! What happened to not dying even if you die?

Entry.JapaneseText: いいんだ…… ボクの誓いも夢も ど〜せ、いつも挫折するのさぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: It's fine... all my promises and dreams only ever end in failure...

Entry.JapaneseText: 巨大ワームの鳴き声……!? 獲物を見つけたのかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: Was that the sandworm's cry...?! Don't tell me it's found its prey.
Prey...? You don't mean the guys, right?!

Entry.JapaneseText: さあ？ ここで死ぬあなたには 誰でも関係ないでしょ
Entry.EnglishText: Who can say? What different does it matter to someone who's ready to lay down and die here?
Oh, you still haven't died yet?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……死なない！ 生きて……助けるっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: ...I'm not dying! I gotta keep living!!

Entry.JapaneseText: うふふ、また失敗。 ほんと余計な事は言わない方が いいわねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe, there she goes again. I really should learn to keep my mouth shut.

Entry.JapaneseText: 方角を……見失っちゃった…… はは……こりゃ、本当に抜け 出すのに『千夜』かかるかもね
Entry.EnglishText: Which way's which... haha, I really goofed up again. Maybe it really DOES take a thousand nights to ge outta here.
Aaah?!
Shing...!

Entry.JapaneseText: あきらめないで……わたしの友達は 二千年も……たったひとりで ゼロムから世界を守ってきたの……
Entry.EnglishText: We can't give up... My friend has been protected the world from the xerom all by herself for more than 2000 years...

Entry.JapaneseText: その苦しさに比べたら これくらいなんでもない……よ
Entry.EnglishText: Compared to the suffering she's been though... this is nothing.

Entry.JapaneseText: その友達って…… リチアだよね？ 彼女は本当に 古代人のスピリアなのか？
Entry.EnglishText: That friends would be... Lithia, right? Is she really one of those ancient's Spiria?

Entry.JapaneseText: お兄ちゃんは信じてくれないけど リチアは、わたしが生まれてから ずっと一緒にいた大切な友達なの
Entry.EnglishText: Hisui never believed me, but she's my closest friend who's always been with me, ever since I was born.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……信じるよ。 でも、なんでリチアは きみのスピリアの中に？
Entry.EnglishText: ...I believe you. But, what is she doing in your Spiria?

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしは お母さんのスピリアから リチアを受け継いだの……
Entry.EnglishText: She was passed down from my mother's Spiria to mine...

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアは彼女の力を狙う者から 逃げるため……体を眠らせ スピリアだけの存在になって
Entry.EnglishText: In order to escape those who wanted her powers for themselves... she put her body to sleep, living on as just a Spiria.

Entry.JapaneseText: 二千年も人のスピルメイズの中に 隠れ続けてきたんだって……
Entry.EnglishText: She's stayed hidden within people's Spirmazes of over 2000 years...

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアの力を狙う者…… 女魔道士インカローズかッ!?
Entry.EnglishText: People who want her power... you mean Incarose?!

Entry.JapaneseText: うん。わたしがあいつに見つかった から、リチアはバラバラになって ゼロムが世界に溢れちゃった……
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah. Because she found me, we had to shatter my Spiria to keep her safe. Or else, the world would be overrun by xerom...

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、スピルーンが集まったら リチアも復活するんだろ!? ゼロムも封印できるんじゃないの？
Entry.EnglishText: Wait, so if we gather all the Spirunes, Lithia will be ressurected right?! And you said she can seal the xerom?

Entry.JapaneseText: だめ……スピリアだけのリチアが 隠れながらゼロムを封印するのは もう……限界なんだって……
Entry.EnglishText: Not quite... the best she can do as a Spiria is keep the xerom at bay but... she's reaching her limit...

Entry.JapaneseText: ある場所に眠るリチアの本当の体を 目覚めさせた時、初めてゼロムは 完全に封印される……
Entry.EnglishText: The xerom can only truly be sealed once she's returned to her body she hid away...

Entry.JapaneseText: そのために、わたしたちは旅に 出た……『そこ』に彼女を送り 届けるのが、リチアとの約束なの
Entry.EnglishText: That's why I set out on this journey... I promised I would take her back “there”.

Entry.JapaneseText: そっか…… そのリチアとの約束があるから きみは強いんだね
Entry.EnglishText: I see... you're so strong because you made her a promise.

Entry.JapaneseText: ううん。わたしが……ひとりじゃ ないからだよ。みんなが助けて くれるから……頑張れるの
Entry.EnglishText: That's not it. It's because... I'm not alone. Everyone is here to help me so... I can keep fighting.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kohaku>、改めて約束するよ。 力を合わせて、きみとリチアを 元に戻そう！
Entry.EnglishText: Then let's make another promise. I promise i'll do everything I can to restore both you AND Lithia!

Entry.JapaneseText: そして、ゼロムを封印するんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: And then, we can seal the xerom for good!
...Yeah. We'll do this together.

Entry.JapaneseText: あっ、今一瞬、白い月が見えたよ！ この時期に月があの位置に あるって事は……北はあっちだ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, just for a second, I saw the Ivory Moon! Given it's position the time of year that means... north is that way!!

Entry.EnglishText: Everyone's Soma Link went up.
